newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: RAM assigns AA1 rating to OCBC Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: RAM assigns AA1 rating to OCBC Malaysia.

text.p: Rating Agency Malaysia Bhd (RAM) said on Monday it had assigned a long-term rating of AA1 to OCBC Bank (Malaysia) Bhd.
In a statement, RAM said it had also accorded a short-term rating of P1 to the bank, a subsidiary of Singapore-listed Oversea Chinese Banking Corporation Ltd.

"The ratings reflect the bank's superior asset quality which stem's from the bank's conservative lending philosophy and tight controls," RAM said. "The rating also recognises the bank's strong profitability and cost efficiency".
OCBC Malaysia's gross non-performing loans to gross loans ratio at 1.7 percent as at end-December 1995 "ranks among the lowest in Malaysia", the rating agency said.
The bank's asset quality is boosted by conservative specific provisioning and interest suspension policies.
RAM said it also took comfort from the inherent support the Malaysian bank receives from its Singapore parent.
